title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: users can upload local and OneDrive files to custom engine agents
summary: Hold: the blanket assurance that licensed users incur no additional charges is not supported by the current licensing documentation. Blocking an agent does not necessarily stop its use outside Copilot Chat, and the page also overlooks an existing maker-side upload setting for Copilot Studio agents.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Plan licensing and cost says users generally need no Copilot licence to access custom engine agents in Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: Searched: custom engine agents don't need license Chat; cost-considerations custom engine charges. Opened cost-considerations and billing-licensing; read FAQ and admin-guide licensing passages. The cited cost page no longer states this general licence rule.
claims.fix: Replace the general licence statement in both places with: 'The Agents admin guide documents Copilot Studio agents in Copilot Chat under Microsoft 365 Copilot licences or pay-as-you-go models; check the licensing for the selected agent and capabilities.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/agent-essentials/m365-agents-admin-guide.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence incur no additional charges for custom engine agents in general.
claims.quote: Searched: custom engine agents license Credits shared; cost-considerations custom engine charges. Opened cost-considerations and billing-licensing. The latter's exemption covers named standard-harness activities with the user's authenticated identity, not all custom engine usage.
claims.fix: Remove the blanket no-additional-charge statement from licensing.notes and Cost and licensing. If retaining an exemption, use: 'For Copilot Studio standard-harness agents, classic answers, generative answers and Microsoft Graph tenant grounding in Copilot Chat, Teams or SharePoint are not charged for a Microsoft 365 Copilot license holder when the agent runs with that user's authenticated identity.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/billing-licensing.
